# AutoCliper

> Turn long YouTube, Kick, Twitch, Drive, and Dropbox videos into short viral clips using AI.

AutoCliper uses AI to automatically find the best moments in long videos and clip them into short-form content ready for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://autocliper.com/)
- [Pricing](https://autocliper.com/pricing)
- [Terms](https://autocliper.com/terms)
- [Privacy](https://autocliper.com/privacy)

## Features
- AI-powered clip selection (loudest, most engaging moments)
- Supports YouTube, Kick, Twitch, Google Drive, Dropbox
- Up to 10 clips per video
- Download all clips as ZIP
- Works for Shorts, Reels, and TikTok formats
